annotation.authors_or_issuer: 深圳市人民代表大会常务委员会 (Standing Committee of Shenzhen Municipal People's Congress)
key_provisions_or_claims: Defines conditionally, highly and fully automated intelligent connected vehicles and requires driver presence for L3/L4 vehicles.
Product market-access catalogue, local standards, testing and registration required before sale and road use.
Mandatory insurance and connection of vehicle data to government monitoring platform; event data recording of at least 90 seconds before incident.
Liability: driver liable for driver-present vehicles; owner/manager for driverless; recourse against manufacturer for defects.
Cybersecurity, data localisation and bans on illegal personal data collection; penalties and recall duties.
annotation.summary_en: Shenzhen Special Economic Zone regulation on intelligent connected (autonomous) vehicles, adopted 23 June 2022, effective 1 August 2022. It sets road testing, market access, registration, use, vehicle-road infrastructure, cybersecurity/data protection, accident liability and penalties for L3–L5 vehicles.

annotation.title_en: Regulations on the Management of Intelligent Connected Vehicles in the Shenzhen Special Economic Zone
